result: From the books so far (1 Jan – 7 Oct 2026), § 7 income is 803 622,31 Kč and actual expenses 261 220,00 Kč. With actual expenses, tax and insurance come to 174 244 Kč: income tax 50 520 Kč, social insurance 87 111 Kč and health insurance 36 613 Kč. Claiming the 60 % flat rate instead counts 482 173,38 Kč of expenses and brings the total to 90 693 Kč, which is 83 551 Kč less. The flip side: the social insurance assessment base, from which your pension is later worked out, falls by 121 525 Kč. These are figures for the year so far, not a projection, and paušální daň isn't assessed because the rule pack doesn't hold the 2026 bands yet. A scenario for your review, not tax advice.

levers: Expenses: actual or the 60 % flat rate
